description: A checkbox with a label or a label slot, a description, and an optional value for when it is off. Works with Livewire wire:model, as one box or a list on an array.

consider.note: An unticked box sends nothing, so a value left out of the request never turns off. Read it with `$request->boolean()`, or give the box `unchecked-value="0"`, and validate it with `boolean`.
For terms or consent, validate with `accepted`, and consider saving when it was given and to which version, so you can show it later.
